structured.answer: At my age I could take it out after 3 years without tax (others wait 6). How much I'd have I couldn't really tell: with 300 ₪ a month from me and 900 from the employer the page showed about 54,000 put in over 5 years, roughly 66,000 at the end, and a red −13,974 for tax. I'll ask my son or the bank before deciding.

findings.what: Default result is at 5 years, so a red minus (−13,974) and striped tax box come first and scare you off
No single plain sentence with the amount you'd end up with; too many numbers
Final number hidden behind the round scroll-up button
English letters and 'מדד' used for a stock index without explanation
Dark background with grey small text is hard to read
findings.where: Chart hint line, column labels, whole page

findings.what: Codes like KH-19 and 'חוקים וכללים · 10' mean nothing
